name: yara
description: Pattern matching engine for malware identification and classification in security research

tools.description: Scan files and processes using YARA rules to identify malware and suspicious patterns
tools.usage:
yara32 rules.yar suspicious_file.exe # Scan file with rules
yara32 -r rules.yar /path/to/scan # Recursive directory scan
yara32 -p 1234 rules.yar # Scan running process by PID
yara32 -s rules.yar file.exe # Show matching strings
yara32 -g rules.yar file.exe # Print tags and metadata

tools.description: Compile YARA rules into binary format for faster scanning and distribution
tools.usage:
yarac32 rules.yar rules.yarc # Compile rules to binary
yarac32 -d symbol=value rules.yar # Define external variables
yarac32 -n namespace rules.yar # Specify rule namespace
yarac32 -w rules.yar # Show compilation warnings
